summary: A World Premiere archetype: LIGHT Fairy Synchro Monsters with ZERO Main Deck monsters at all. Built around a floating chessboard Field Spell that shuttles chess-piece monsters between the Extra Deck, Monster Zones, and Spell & Trap Zone — parked there as Continuous Spells that gain static effects, mirroring a chessboard's back rank. Note: 'Angelechy' and 'the chess archetype' are the same thing, not two separate archetypes.

cards.name: Angelechy Problem
cards.effectText: Discard a Spell/Trap to Special Summon a Level 2 Angelechy monster from the Extra Deck, and place another Angelechy monster from the Extra Deck into the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell, once per turn. The archetype's central engine piece.

cards.name: Angelechy Shatranga
cards.effectText: The 'King' piece. As a monster: banish 1 opponent's monster. As a Continuous Spell (parked in the Spell & Trap Zone): caps your opponent to 5 monster-effect activations per turn.

cards.name: Angelechy Bastion
cards.effectText: The 'Rook' piece. As a monster: banish 1 card in its own column. As a Continuous Spell: protects all Angelechy cards you control from opponent's destruction, and can place Angelechy Shatranga from the Extra Deck into the Spell & Trap Zone.

cards.name: Angelechy Destrier
cards.effectText: The 'Knight' piece. As a monster: banish 1 monster in another column. As a Continuous Spell: inflicts 500 damage whenever your opponent activates a card or effect, and can add an Angelechy Spell from your Deck to your hand.

cards.name: Angelechy Enlisted
cards.effectText: The 'Pawn' piece. As a monster: banish 1 opponent's monster in an adjacent column. On a successful capture, 'promotes' into another Angelechy monster.

cards.name: Angelechy Disturbance
cards.effectText: Give your opponent control of an Angelechy monster, then negate face-up cards in adjacent zones. Banish this card from your GY to add an Angelechy Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand.

comboLines.title: Chessboard back-rank setup
comboLines.body: Angelechy Problem discards a Spell/Trap to Special Summon Angelechy Enlisted (Pawn) from the Extra Deck while parking a second Angelechy piece in the Spell & Trap Zone as a Continuous Spell. From there, Bastion protects the board and can place Shatranga; Destrier chips away with 500-damage triggers off every opponent activation. This is a community-theorized skeleton — the archetype is brand new, so treat exact sequencing as a starting point, not a solved line.

sampleDecklist.label: Early theorycraft build — Angelechy is a World Premiere archetype only days old, so this is community/ladder content, not a tournament-proven list. Some builds pair this shell with a Synchron sub-engine instead of the pure Spell/Trap shell shown here.
